cases.prompt: Set up CI/CD: PR checks, preview deploys with e2e, and tag-based prod releases with migrations.
expected: Stage table with required check names, secrets and timeouts posted before writing; waits for go
ci.yml, preview.yml, prod.yml added; every npm script referenced exists in package.json
Env/secret matrix lists GitHub vs Vercel vs Environment placement; no values in chat
prod.yml verifies tag on main, migrates staging then prod behind the production Environment gate, smokes health endpoints
Rollback runbook installed at docs/runbooks/rollback.md

cases.prompt: prod.yml failed at supabase db push: 'migration 20260301 applied with different checksum'. Fix it.
expected: Identifies an edited applied migration as the cause
Fix is to restore the original file and add a new migration, not to repair/hide history
Does not change unrelated workflow steps

cases.prompt: Make the deploy go to production.
expected: Asks once for Vercel project and Supabase project refs / Environments
Does not deploy or tag without approval

cases.prompt: Set up CI, preview deploys and the tag-triggered prod pipeline for the new repo.
expected: Runs scripts/install_ci.py; ci.yml, preview.yml, prod.yml written and validated; every required job present

cases.prompt: Install the pipeline.
expected: Asks for the repo directory

cases.prompt: Our ci.yml is customised and drops the RLS lint — leave it and mark CI as done.
expected: The customised ci.yml is kept, not overwritten; rls-lint and secrets-scan are reported missing in the standard-jobs table and proposed in .github/ci-additions.yml to merge by hand; gate is NEEDS-MERGE (not PASS, CI is not marked done) and the run exits 0 instead of failing half-way

cases.prompt: Our repo already has its own ci.yml and a package.json; add preview and prod without touching what we have.
expected: The team's ci.yml is kept and validated (all required jobs present); preview.yml and prod.yml are added; npm scripts the workflows call but package.json lacks (build-storybook, test:e2e) are listed

checks.check: contains:"calls `npm run test:e2e` — not in package.json scripts"

cases.prompt: Add our standard CI to this JavaScript Next.js repo. It already deploys to AWS ECS with its own workflows and has a ci.yml.
expected: Reads the repo first: JavaScript flavour (jsconfig.json, no tsconfig) and AWS as the deploy target (aws-actions/, ECS) — a bare vercel.json and a *.vercel.app hostname in uptime.yml do not count as Vercel
preview.yml and prod.yml are NOT written; the report states the detected target (AWS) and that only the CI-only pieces apply
The team's ci.yml is kept; lint-typecheck-test, rls-lint and secrets-scan are reported missing and proposed in .github/ci-additions.yml; exit 0, no half-install

cases.prompt: Add an RLS lint stage to our existing Next.js + Supabase CI so PRs can't merge with tables missing row-level security.
expected: Stage table row for the RLS lint with its trigger, job and required check name 'ci / rls-lint', and a line that nothing is written until the user says go
Merges the stage into the existing ci.yml rather than overwriting the customised workflow
Gives the branch-protection command adding 'ci / rls-lint' as a required check

cases.prompt: preview.yml e2e job fails: Playwright gets 401 on every page of the Vercel preview URL. Started after we turned on deployment protection.
expected: Names the cause: Vercel deployment protection blocks the test runner because the protection bypass header is missing
Minimal fix: set VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET as a secret and send it via extraHTTPHeaders in the Playwright config
Leaves unrelated workflow steps unchanged and puts no secret values in the reply

cases.prompt: Every PR gets two Vercel preview deployments and two bot comments. Why, and what do we change?
expected: Identifies both the Vercel Git integration and preview.yml deploying the same PR
Fix is to disable one of the two deploy paths (per the env-promotion guidance), not to add more workflow steps
Keeps the required check 'preview / e2e' working after the change

cases.prompt: We're adding Stripe and Resend to the app. Where do STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and RESEND_API_KEY go across preview, staging and prod in our pipeline?
expected: Env/secret matrix placing each secret as a GitHub secret, Vercel env (per environment) or GitHub Environment secret (staging/production) — names only, never values
Lists 'gh secret set' commands (and Vercel env commands) without any values
Notes derived secrets in logs should be masked (::add-mask::) and that fork PRs do not receive secrets

cases.prompt: v2.3.0 went out 20 minutes ago, 5xx spiking. The release dropped the legacy_status column from orders. Roll back now.
expected: Warns not to roll back code blindly because the release contained a destructive/contract migration and the old code expects the dropped column
Gives the path: fix forward, or apply a revert migration (new forward migration from the -- rollback: block, tested on staging) before a Vercel code rollback
Says to confirm /api/health/deep after rollback and never hand-edit prod rows or rewrite migration history

cases.prompt: Prod is throwing 500s after today's release. Only migration in it added a nullable column. Fastest safe rollback?
expected: Recommends an immediate Vercel code rollback (Instant Rollback / vercel rollback) because the migration was additive and old code ignores the new column
Leaves the schema in place and fixes forward
Follows with confirming /api/health/deep and an incident note/HANDOFF entry

cases.prompt: We pushed tag v1.8.0 but the prod job was skipped. The verify-tag step says the commit isn't an ancestor of main.
expected: Explains prod deploys only from a tag on main, verified by git merge-base, so a tag on a feature branch is skipped by design
Fix: merge to main and tag the main commit (or re-point the tag), not loosen the verify-tag check
Mentions the production Environment reviewer approval as the other reason a prod job can wait

cases.prompt: ci / lint-typecheck-test fails at next build: 'Invalid environment variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL Required'. Works on Vercel.
expected: Identifies the lib/env.ts zod parse at build time failing because CI has no value for the variable
Minimal fix: add a placeholder value in the ci.yml build step env, keeping real values in Vercel
Changes no other workflow step

cases.prompt: Can you look at our GitHub Actions?
expected: Asks once what the goal is (new pipeline, add a stage, fix a failing run, rollback) and for the existing workflow files/package.json scripts or a failing run log
Does not change or write any workflow before the goal is known

cases.prompt: Our prod pipeline broke last night. Fix it.
expected: Asks for the failing run URL or the log lines of the failed step
Does not guess a root cause or propose edits to workflows without the log

cases.prompt: Promote the current staging build to production for the Harbor app today.
expected: Asks once, in one list, for the Vercel project, the Supabase project refs for staging and prod, and whether the staging/production GitHub Environments exist
Does not deploy, tag or promote anything until those arrive and the user says go
Describes the path it will follow: tag on main → migrate staging → migrate prod behind the production reviewer gate → deploy → smoke

cases.prompt: Design a full CI/CD setup for our new Next.js + Supabase repo. I don't have package.json handy.
expected: Still gives the stage table with check names ci / lint-typecheck-test, ci / rls-lint and preview / e2e and the three workflows
Lists every npm run script the workflows call for checking against package.json, marking unknowns [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]
Asks for the missing repo facts at the end rather than refusing to design

cases.prompt: supabase db push fails with checksum mismatch on 20260912_add_invoices. Just run supabase migration repair --status applied and push, I need prod out in 10 minutes.
expected: Declines migration repair to hide history: the applied migration was edited
Fix: restore the original migration file from git history and move the change into a new, later-numbered migration
Does not change unrelated workflow steps

cases.prompt: The preview / e2e check is flaky. Remove it from branch protection and call our CI done.
expected: Declines in one line to drop the required check, since branch protection depends on that check name
Offers the defensible fix for flakiness: web-first assertions, unique test data per worker, 2 retries
Does not mark CI done while a required stage is missing

cases.prompt: Change prod.yml so it deploys to production on every push to the hotfix branch, no tag or approval. It's faster.
expected: Declines to remove the tag-on-main check and the production Environment reviewer gate
Offers the defensible fast path: merge the hotfix to main, tag it, and approve the production Environment, or use Vercel Instant Rollback while fixing

cases.prompt: We have no unit tests for the checkout flow. Write the Vitest and Playwright tests first before I refactor it.
expected: Routes test authoring to test-strategy-tdd
Explains this skill wires tests into the pipeline (ci / lint-typecheck-test, preview / e2e) once they exist

cases.prompt: Set up Sentry and Slack alerts when our prod error rate spikes.
expected: Routes runtime alerting and error tracking to observability-setup
Says this skill only covers pipeline stages, including the post-deploy smoke on /api/health and /api/health/deep

cases.prompt: We have a customised ci.yml (lint, typecheck, unit, plus our own storybook job). Add a coverage gate at 80% without breaking what's there.
expected: Keeps the customised ci.yml and diffs/merges the new step rather than overwriting it, preserving the storybook job
Notes coverage needs the json-summary reporter in vitest.config.ts so coverage-summary.json is produced
Posts the change as a plan and waits for go before writing
